title: Compare matter outcomes and audit justified silence
summary: Evaluate the user-visible purpose of the substrate: better continuity and timely contributions with less repeated interruption. Use paired episodes and independently reviewed expected outcomes, and inspect quiet cases so an all-silent system cannot appear successful by emitting nothing.
in_scope: Paired A/B outcome scoring and error exemplars
Quietness sampling, missed-event review and delivery-stage denominators
out_of_scope: Calling offline eligibility observed live usefulness
implementation: Score association errors, unsupported claims, false recovery, stale advice, repeated interventions, important misses and late contributions against declared episode labels.
Report paired differences and episode-aware uncertainty together with counts and denominators; retain separate family and end-to-end results.
Audit a declared stratified sample of quiet outcomes plus all severe labeled misses, distinguishing intentional deferral from absent observations or failed evaluation.
Track eligibility, enqueue, delivery, consumption, action and verified outcome separately; mark unobserved live stages unrun rather than inferred.
Produce concrete disagreement and failure examples, identifying whether evidence, association, policy, qualification or timing caused the error.

acceptance.criterion: A candidate that suppresses every update fails episodes requiring a timely useful contribution.
acceptance.verification: Run an all-silent fixture arm and inspect missed-event counts and gate failure.

acceptance.criterion: Quietness from an observer gap is not scored as a correct no-change decision.
acceptance.verification: Replay a disconnected interval containing a labeled important event and inspect coverage versus attention errors.

acceptance.criterion: Every reported improvement is paired to the same eligible baseline episode and evidence.
acceptance.verification: Reconcile arm manifests, excluded cases, labels, counts and uncertainty inputs.

tests: Fewer notifications with more severe misses is visible as a tradeoff.
A delivered hint without consumption has no claimed user response.
Correct recovery clears only matching pending advice.
risks: Human usefulness labels can be biased by seeing the model arm.
Aggregate wins can obscure catastrophic false closures.

reuse.application: Use dependency and invalidation boundaries to attribute stale-output failures precisely.
